      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%1%%%-->
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">This STOCKHOLDER AND REGISTRATION RIGHTS AGREEMENT (this &#8220;<u>Agreement</u>&#8221;), dated as of [&#9679;], 20[&#9679;] (the &#8220;<u>Effective Date</u>&#8221;), is made by and between Trinzic, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;<u>SpinCo</u>&#8221;), and
        KBR, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;<u>Company</u>&#8221;), on behalf of itself and any of its subsidiaries that hold or acquire shares of Common Stock (as defined below).&#160; Capitalized terms that are used but not otherwise defined in this preamble or
        the recitals shall have the respective meanings ascribed to such terms in <u>Section 1.01</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-align: center;">RECITALS</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">WHEREAS, pursuant to the Separation and Distribution Agreement (the &#8220;<u>Separation and Distribution Agreement</u>&#8221;), dated as of [&#9679;], 20[&#9679;], by and between the Company and SpinCo, the Company intends, upon the terms
        and conditions set forth therein and in accordance with the Internal Reorganization, to separate the SpinCo Business such that, as of the Distribution, the SpinCo Business is held by SpinCo;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">WHEREAS, upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Separation and Distribution Agreement, the Company intends to make a <font style="font-style: italic;">pro rata</font> distribution <a name="z_Hlk218888052"></a>of [&#9679;]% of the outstanding shares of Common Stock (the &#8220;<u>Distribution</u>&#8221;), and [&#9679;]% of the outstanding shares of Common Stock will be retained by the Company (the &#8220;<u>Remaining Shares</u>&#8221;), which shares will
        constitute Registrable Securities hereunder;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">WHEREAS, following the Distribution, the Company may Transfer such Registrable Securities through (i) one or more Debt Exchanges, (ii) distributions to the Company&#8217;s stockholders as dividends or in exchange for
        outstanding shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of the Company following the Distribution, or (iii) one or more public offerings or other sales or dispositions, which may include one or more transactions Registered under the
        Securities Act, in each case, on the terms and subject to the conditions of this Agreement and in accordance with the Tax Matters Agreement and the IRS Ruling;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">WHEREAS, in furtherance of the foregoing, SpinCo desires to grant to the Company certain registration rights as set forth in, and on the terms and subject to the conditions of, this Agreement; and</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">WHEREAS, the Company desires to grant to SpinCo a proxy to vote the Remaining Shares in direct proportion to the votes cast by SpinCo&#8217;s other stockholders, on the terms and subject to the conditions of this Agreement.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual promises, covenants and agreements of the parties hereto, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby
        acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows:</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">1</font></div>

      <div style="text-align: center;"><u>Definitions</u></div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709096"></a>Section 1.01.&#160; <u>Certain Definitions</u>.&#160; As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the following meanings:</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Adverse Disclosure</u>&#8221; means public disclosure of material, non-public information that, in the Board&#8217;s good faith judgment, (i) after consultation with outside legal counsel to SpinCo, would be required to be
        made in any Registration Statement filed with the SEC by SpinCo so that such Registration Statement would not be materially misleading and would not be required to be made at such time but for the filing of such Registration Statement, and (ii) in
        SpinCo&#8217;s sole, good faith determination, would be materially detrimental to SpinCo.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Affiliate</u>&#8221; means, with respect to any Person, any other Person who, as of the relevant time for which the determination of affiliation is being made, directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by or is
        under common control with such Person; <u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, that SpinCo and each Subsidiary of SpinCo shall be deemed not to be an Affiliate of the Company.&#160; For the purposes of this definition, the term &#8220;<u>control</u>&#8221; (including,
        with correlative meanings, the terms &#8220;<u>controlling</u>,&#8221; &#8220;<u>controlled by</u>&#8221; and &#8220;<u>under common control with</u>&#8221;), as used with respect to any Person, means the possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the
        direction of the management and policies of such Person, whether through the ownership of voting securities, by contract or otherwise.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Agreement</u>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Ancillary Agreements</u>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the Separation and Distribution Agreement.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Blackout Notice</u>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <u>Section 4.03(c)</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Blackout Period</u>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <u>Section 4.03(c)</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Board</u>&#8221; means the Board of Directors of SpinCo.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Business Day</u>&#8221; means any day that is not a Saturday, a Sunday or other day on which banking institutions are authorized or obligated by law to be closed in New York, New York.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Claim Notice</u>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <u>Section 4.13(a)</u>.</div>

        Participating Banks in exchange for the satisfaction of Debt held by any of the Company Group&#8217;s creditors, in a transaction or transactions not required to be Registered under the Securities Act.</div>

        recapitalization, stock split or combination, exchange or readjustment of such Common Stock, any stock dividend or stock distribution in respect of such Common Stock, or any similar transaction in respect of such Common Stock, in each case whether
        now owned or hereafter acquired; <u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, that any such Registrable Securities shall cease to be Registrable Securities to the extent (a) a Registration Statement with respect to the Sale of such Registrable Securities has
        become effective under the Securities Act and such Registrable Securities have been disposed of in accordance with the plan of distribution set forth in such Registration Statement, (b) such Registrable Securities have been Sold or distributed to a
        Person other than a Transferee pursuant to Rule 144 or Rule 145 of the Securities Act (or any successor rule) and new certificates or book entries for them not bearing a legend restricting transfer have been delivered by SpinCo, (c) such
        Registrable Securities have been otherwise Sold or disposed of to a Person other than a Transferee and new certificates or book entries for them not bearing a legend restricting transfer have been delivered by SpinCo and such securities may be
        publicly resold without volume limitations or other restrictions on transfer without Registration under the Securities Act or (d) such Registrable Securities cease to be outstanding.</div>

        meanings.</div>

      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709097"></a>Section 1.02.&#160; <u>Interpretation</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Unless the context of this Agreement otherwise requires:</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 81pt;">the heading references herein and in the table of contents hereto are for convenience purposes only, do not constitute a part of this Agreement and shall not be deemed to limit or affect any of
        the provisions hereof;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 81pt;">(A) words of any gender include each other gender and neuter form; (B) words using the singular or plural number also include the plural or singular number, respectively; (C) derivative forms of
        defined terms will have correlative meanings; (D) the terms &#8220;hereof&#8221;, &#8220;herein&#8221;, &#8220;hereby&#8221;, &#8220;hereto&#8221;, &#8220;herewith&#8221;, &#8220;hereunder&#8221; and derivative or similar words refer to this entire Agreement; (E) the terms &#8220;Article&#8221;, &#8220;Section&#8221; and &#8220;Exhibit&#8221; refer to
        the specified Article, Section or Exhibit of this Agreement and references to &#8220;subparagraphs&#8221; or &#8220;clauses&#8221; shall be to separate subparagraphs or clauses of the Section or subsection in which the reference occurs; (F) the words &#8220;include&#8221;, &#8220;includes&#8221;
        and &#8220;including&#8221; shall be deemed to be followed by the phrase &#8220;without limitation&#8221;; and (G) the word &#8220;or&#8221; shall be disjunctive but not exclusive;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">6</font></div>

      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(iii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 81pt;">any law defined or referred to in this Agreement or in any agreement or instrument that is referred to herein means such law as from time to time amended, modified or supplemented, including (in
        the case of statutes) by succession of comparable successor laws and the related regulations thereunder and published interpretations thereof, and references to any contract or instrument are to that contract or instrument as from time to time
        amended, modified or supplemented;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(iv)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 81pt;">references to any federal, state, local, or foreign statute or law shall include all regulations promulgated thereunder; and</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(v)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 81pt;">references to any Person include references to such Person&#8217;s successors and permitted assigns.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">The language used in this Agreement shall be deemed to be the language chosen by the parties hereto to express their mutual intent.&#160; The parties hereto acknowledge that each party hereto and its
        attorney has reviewed and participated in the drafting of this Agreement and that any rule of construction to the effect that any ambiguities are to be resolved against the drafting party, or any similar rule operating against the drafter of an
        agreement, shall not be applicable to the construction or interpretation of this Agreement.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Whenever this Agreement refers to a number of days, such number shall refer to calendar days unless Business Days are specified.&#160; If any action is to be taken or given on or by a particular
        calendar day, and such calendar day is not a Business Day, then such action may be deferred until the next Business Day.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(d)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">When calculating the period of time before which, within which or following which any act is to be done or step taken pursuant to this Agreement, the date that is the reference date in
        calculating such period shall be excluded and if the last day of such period is not a Business Day, the period shall end on the next succeeding Business Day.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(e)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">The phrase &#8220;to the extent&#8221; shall mean the degree to which a subject or other thing extends, and such phrase shall not mean simply &#8220;if&#8221;.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(f)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">The terms &#8220;writing,&#8221; &#8220;written&#8221; and comparable terms refer to printing, typing and other means of reproducing words (including electronic media) in a visible form.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(g)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Any Person shall be deemed to &#8220;beneficially own&#8221;, to have &#8220;beneficial ownership&#8221; of, or to be &#8220;beneficially owning&#8221; any securities (which securities shall also be deemed &#8220;beneficially owned&#8221; by
        such Person) that such Person is deemed to &#8220;beneficially own&#8221; within the meaning of Rules 13d-3 and 13d-5 under the Exchange Act.</div>

      <div style="text-align: center;">ARTICLE II</div>
      <div style="text-align: center;"> <br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;"><u>Representations and Warranties</u></div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Except as expressly provided in <u>Section 2.04</u>, each of the parties to this Agreement hereby represents and warrants, severally and not jointly (and solely as to itself), to the other party to this Agreement that
        as of the date such party executes this Agreement:</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709099"></a>Section 2.01.&#160; <u>Existence; Authority; Enforceability</u>.&#160; Such party has the necessary power and authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform its obligations hereunder.&#160; Such
        party is duly organized and validly existing under the laws of its jurisdiction of organization, and the execution of this Agreement, and the performance of its obligations hereunder, have been authorized by all necessary corporate or analogous
        action on its part, and no other act or proceeding on its part is necessary to authorize the execution of this Agreement or the performance of its obligations hereunder.&#160; This Agreement has been duly executed by such party and constitutes its
        legal, valid and binding obligation, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms, subject to the effect of any laws relating to bankruptcy, reorganization, insolvency, moratorium, fraudulent conveyance or preferential transfers, or similar
        laws relating to or affecting creditors&#8217; rights generally and subject, as to enforceability, to the effect of general principles of equity (regardless of whether such enforceability is considered in a proceeding in equity or at law).</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709100"></a>Section 2.02.&#160; <u>Absence of Conflicts</u>.&#160; The execution and delivery by such party of this Agreement and the performance of its obligations hereunder does not and will not (a) conflict
        with, or result in the breach of, any provision of the organizational documents of such party, (b) result in any violation, breach, conflict, default or an event of default (or an event which with notice, lapse of time, or both, would constitute a
        default or an event of default), or give rise to any right of acceleration or termination or any additional material payment obligation, under the terms of any material contract, agreement or permit to which such party is a party or by which such
        party&#8217;s assets or operations are bound or affected, or (c) violate any law applicable to such party, except, in the case of each of clauses (b) and (c) for any such violation, breach, conflict or default that would not impair in any material
        respect the ability of such party to perform its respective obligations hereunder.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709101"></a>Section 2.03.&#160; <u>Consents</u>.&#160; Other than as expressly required herein or any consents which have already been obtained, no material consent, waiver, approval, authorization, exemption,
        registration, license, permit or declaration is required to be made or obtained by such party in connection with the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by such party.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709102"></a>Section 2.04.&#160; <u>Stockholder Representations</u>.&#160; The Company hereby acknowledges that, as of the date hereof, the Common Stock held by the Company has not been Registered under the
        Securities Act or any other applicable law and that such Common Stock may not be Transferred except in compliance with this Agreement and pursuant to the Registration provisions of the Securities Act or an applicable exemption therefrom.</div>

      <div style="text-align: center;">ARTICLE III</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-align: center;"><u>Voting Restrictions</u></div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709104"></a>Section 3.01.&#160; <u>Voting of Common Stock</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">From the date of this Agreement and until the date that the Company Group ceases to own any Remaining Shares, the Company shall, and shall cause each other member of the Company Group to (in each
        case, to the extent that they then own any Remaining Shares), be present, in person or by proxy, at each and every SpinCo stockholder meeting, and otherwise to cause all Remaining Shares then owned by them to be counted as present for purposes of
        establishing a quorum at any such meeting, and to vote on or consent to any matter, or cause to be voted or consented on any such matter, all such Remaining Shares in direct proportion to the votes cast by the other holders of Common Stock on such
        matter.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">From the date of this Agreement and until the date that the Company Group ceases to own any Remaining Shares, the Company hereby grants, and shall cause each other member of the Company Group (in
        each case, to the extent that they own any Remaining Shares) to grant, an irrevocable proxy, which shall be deemed coupled with an interest sufficient under applicable law to support an irrevocable proxy to SpinCo or its designees, to vote, with
        respect to any matter (including waivers of contractual or statutory rights), all Remaining Shares owned by them in direct proportion to the votes cast by the other holders of Common Stock on such matter; <u>provided</u> that (i) such proxy shall
        automatically be revoked as to a particular Remaining Share upon any Transfer of such Remaining Share to a Person other than a member of the Company Group and (ii) nothing in this <u>Section 3.01(b)</u> shall limit or prohibit any such Transfer.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">The Company acknowledges and agrees (on behalf of itself and each member of the Company Group) that SpinCo will be irreparably damaged in the event any of the provisions of this <u>Article III</u>
        are not performed by the Company in accordance with their terms or are otherwise breached.&#160; Accordingly, it is agreed that SpinCo shall be entitled to specific enforcement of the provisions of this <u>Article III</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">9</font></div>

      <div style="text-align: center;">ARTICLE IV</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center;"><u>Registration Rights</u></div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709106"></a>Section 4.01.&#160; <u>Shelf Registration</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Upon the request of the Company from time to time, SpinCo shall use reasonable best efforts to (as promptly as reasonably practicable and, in any event, within 30 days) submit or file a Shelf
        Registration Statement permitting the resale from time to time on a delayed or continuous basis pursuant to Rule 415 of the Securities Act by the Company of all of the Registrable Securities, which shall be filed as an automatically effective
        Registration Statement on Form S-3 if SpinCo is then eligible for such filing (or, if not then eligible, then submitted or filed on Form S-3 if otherwise available, or if neither such form is then available, then on Form S-1 or such other form as
        may be appropriate), and use reasonable best efforts to cause such Shelf Registration Statement to become effective (as promptly as reasonably practicable and, in any event, no later than the earlier of (i) 60 days after such submission or filing,
        (ii) <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">the fifth Business Day after the date SpinCo is notified (orally or in writing, whichever is earlier) by the SEC that such Registration Statement will not be reviewed or will not be subject to further
          review, </font>unless otherwise agreed in writing between the Company and SpinCo, and thereafter keep it effective (including by renewing or refiling upon expiration) until the expiration of the Shelf Period (as defined below)).&#160; Thereafter,
        SpinCo shall, as promptly as reasonably practicable following the written request of the Company for a resale of Registrable Securities (a &#8220;<u>Takedown Request</u>&#8221;), file a prospectus supplement or an amendment (a &#8220;<u>Takedown Prospectus
          Supplement</u>&#8221;) to such Shelf Registration Statement filed under Rule 424 promulgated under the Securities Act as may be necessary to enable resales of the Registrable Securities pursuant to the Company&#8217;s intended method of distribution thereof,
        and to the extent such Takedown Prospectus Supplement is not automatically effective upon filing, shall, subject to the terms of this <u>Article IV</u>, use its reasonable best efforts to cause such Takedown Prospectus Supplement to be declared
        effective under the Securities Act promptly after the filing thereof and, if required, to qualify under the &#8220;blue sky&#8221; laws of such jurisdictions as the Company or any underwriter reasonably requests.&#160; Each Takedown Request shall specify the
        Registrable Securities to be Registered, their aggregate amount, and the intended method or methods of distribution thereof.&#160; The Company agrees to provide SpinCo with such information in connection with any Shelf Registration Statement or Takedown
        Request as may be reasonably requested by SpinCo to ensure that any Shelf Registration Statement or Takedown Prospectus Supplement complies with the requirements of the Securities Act, including any financial statements or other information of the
        SpinCo Business relating to any date or any period ending on or prior to the Distribution Date to the extent required to be included or incorporated by reference in any Shelf Registration Statement or Takedown Prospectus Supplement.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">SpinCo shall use its reasonable best efforts to keep any Shelf Registration Statement filed pursuant to <u>Section 4.01(a)</u> continuously effective under the Securities Act in order to permit
        the Prospectus forming a part thereof to be usable by the Company to effect an offering of all or a portion of its Registrable Securities (such offering, a &#8220;<u>Shelf Take-Down</u>&#8221;) until the earlier of (i) the date as of which the Company no
        longer has any Registrable Securities and (ii) such shorter period as the Company may agree in writing (such period of effectiveness, the &#8220;<u>Shelf Period</u>&#8221;).</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">10</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Section 4.02.&#160; <u>Demand Registration</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">If at any time the Shelf Registration Statement pursuant to <u>Section 4.01</u> is not available for the resale of the Registrable Securities, including if for any reason SpinCo is ineligible to
        maintain or use a Shelf Registration Statement, SpinCo shall use reasonable best efforts to (as promptly as reasonably practicable and, in any event, within 45 days) following the written request of the Company for Registration under the Securities
        Act of all or part of the Company&#8217;s Registrable Securities (a &#8220;<u>Demand Request</u>&#8221;), submit or file a Registration Statement with the SEC (a &#8220;<u>Demand Registration Statement</u>&#8221;) with respect to resales of the Registrable Securities pursuant
        to the Company&#8217;s intended method of distribution thereof, and shall, subject to the terms of this <u>Article IV</u>, use its reasonable best efforts to cause such Demand Registration Statement to be declared effective under the Securities Act
        (promptly and, in any event, no later than the earlier of (i) 60 days after such filing and (ii) <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">the fifth Business Day after the date </font>SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> is notified (orally or in
          writing, whichever is earlier) by the SEC that such Registration Statement will not be reviewed or will not be subject to further review</font>), unless otherwise agreed in writing between the Company and SpinCo, and, if required, to qualify
        under the &#8220;blue sky&#8221; laws of such jurisdictions as the Company or any underwriter reasonably requests; <u>provided</u> that such Demand Registration Statement shall be submitted or filed on an appropriate form under the Securities Act for the type
        of offering contemplated by the Company.&#160; Each Demand Request shall specify the Registrable Securities to be Registered, their aggregate amount, and the intended method or methods of distribution thereof.&#160; The Company agrees to provide SpinCo with
        such information in connection with a Demand Request as may be reasonably requested by SpinCo to ensure that the Demand Registration Statement complies with the requirements of the Securities Act, including any financial statements or other
        information of the SpinCo Business relating to any date or any period ending on or prior to the Distribution Date to the extent required to be included or incorporated by reference in any Demand Registration Statement and not already in the
        possession of SpinCo.&#160; Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, SpinCo shall only be obligated to use reasonable best efforts to file and cause up to five Demand Registration Statements to be declared effective, and no more than
        three Demand Registration Statements within any twelve-month period, under the Securities Act, and SpinCo shall not be obligated to file a Demand Registration Statement within 60 days after the effective date of a previous registration by SpinCo
        pursuant to this Agreement, other than a Shelf Registration Statement effected pursuant to <u>Section 4.01</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">SpinCo shall be deemed to have effected a Demand Registration for purposes of this <u>Section 4.02</u>, <u>Section 4.03(a)</u> and <u>Section 4.04(a)</u> if the Demand Registration Statement
        is declared effective by the SEC and remains effective until the earlier of (i) 90 days after the effective date and (ii) such time as all Registrable Securities covered by such Registration Statement have been Sold or withdrawn in accordance with
        this <u>Section 4.02</u>, or if such Registration Statement relates to an Underwritten Offering (as defined below), such longer period as, in the opinion of outside legal counsel for the underwriter or underwriters, a Prospectus is required by law
        to be delivered in connection with Sales of Registrable Securities by an underwriter or dealer (the applicable period, the &#8220;<u>Demand Period</u>&#8221;); <u>provided</u> that (i) if, during the Demand Period, such Registration or the successful
        completion of the relevant Sale is prevented by any stop order, injunction or other order or requirement of the SEC or other governmental agency or court, or a Blackout Period, or the need to update or supplement the Registration Statement, the
        Demand Period shall be extended on a day-for-day basis by the number of days such Registration or successful completion of such Sale is prevented and (ii) no Demand Registration shall be deemed to have been effective for purposes of <u>Section
          4.03(a)</u> and <u>Section 4.04(a)</u> if the conditions to closing specified in the underwriting agreement, if any, entered into in connection with any Underwritten Offering pursuant to such Demand Registration are not satisfied other than by
        reason of a wrongful act, misrepresentation or breach of such applicable underwriting agreement by the Company.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709108"></a>Section 4.03.&#160; <u>Registration Obligations</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Notwithstanding anything to the contrary set forth in <u>Section 4.01</u> or <u>Section 4.02</u>, SpinCo shall not be obligated to prepare, file and cause to become effective (i) more than five
        Demand Registration Statements, and no more than three Demand Registration Statements within any twelve-month period, or (ii) any Demand Registration Statement in respect of Registrable Securities if the expected proceeds (or, in the case of a Debt
        Exchange, the anticipated fair value of the securities Transferred or indebtedness satisfied) from the Sale thereof is less than $25,000,000 (unless the Company is proposing to Sell all of its remaining Registrable Securities).</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">11</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Any Takedown Request or Demand Request may be revoked by notice from the Company to SpinCo at any time prior to the effective date of the corresponding Takedown Prospectus Supplement or Demand
        Registration Statement; <u>provided</u> that the Company reimburses SpinCo for all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket expenses incurred by SpinCo in connection with such revoked Takedown Request or Demand Request.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, SpinCo shall be entitled to postpone and delay, for the shortest period reasonably practicable and, in any event, on no more than one
        occasion not to exceed 30 days in any twelve-month period (a &#8220;<u>Blackout Period</u>&#8221;), the filing or effectiveness of any Takedown Prospectus Supplement or Demand Registration Statement or the offer or Sale of any Registrable Securities thereunder
        if the Board shall determine in good faith that such filing or effectiveness or such offering or Sale of any Registrable Securities thereunder, as applicable, would (i) based on advice from a nationally recognized investment banker or financial
        advisor to SpinCo, materially impede, delay or otherwise interfere with any pending or contemplated material acquisition, disposition, corporate reorganization or other similar material transaction involving SpinCo, (ii) based on advice from a
        nationally recognized investment banker or financial advisor to SpinCo, materially and adversely impede, delay or otherwise materially and adversely interfere with any pending or contemplated debt financing by SpinCo, or (iii) require Adverse
        Disclosure (together with clause (i) and (ii), the &#8220;<u>Disadvantageous Disclosure</u>&#8221;).&#160; Upon notice by SpinCo to the Company of any such determination (a &#8220;<u>Blackout Notice</u>&#8221;), the Company shall, except as required by applicable law,
        including any disclosure obligations under Section 13 of the Exchange Act, keep the fact of any such Blackout Notice strictly confidential, and during any Blackout Period, promptly halt any offer, Sale, trading or Transfer (other than a
        distribution to stockholders of the Company that does not require SpinCo to file a Registration Statement after the date of this Agreement or any offer, Sale, trading or Transfer that does not require registration under the Securities Act and is
        not prohibited by applicable law) by it of any Common Stock for the duration of the Blackout Period set forth in such notice (or until such Blackout Period shall be earlier terminated by written notice by SpinCo to the Company) and promptly halt
        any use, publication, dissemination or distribution of any Prospectus or prospectus supplement covering such Registrable Securities for the duration of the Blackout Period set forth in such notice (or until such Blackout Period shall be earlier
        terminated in writing by SpinCo). Upon the receipt of any such Blackout Notice, the Company shall forthwith discontinue use of any Prospectus or prospectus supplement contained in any effective Registration Statement; provided that, if at the time
        of receipt of such Blackout Notice, the Company shall have Sold its Registrable Securities (or has signed a firm commitment underwriting agreement or other definitive agreement with respect to the sale of such Registrable Securities), the Company
        may complete such transaction irrespective of the receipt of such Blackout Notice, and SpinCo shall take such actions, if any, as may be reasonably necessary to permit the same. When any Disadvantageous Disclosure as to which a Blackout Notice has
        been previously delivered shall cease to be required, SpinCo shall as soon as reasonably practicable notify the Company and take such actions in respect of such Registration Statement as are otherwise required by this Agreement.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">12</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Section 4.04.&#160; <u>Underwritten Offering</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">At any time after the Shelf Registration Statement required pursuant to <u>Section 4.01</u> becomes effective, or as part of a Demand Request in accordance with <u>Section 4.02</u>, the Company
        may deliver a written notice to SpinCo (the &#8220;<u>Underwritten Offering Notice</u>&#8221;) specifying that the Sale of some or all of the Registrable Securities subject to such Shelf Registration Statement or Demand Registration Statement is intended to be
        conducted through an underwritten offering (the &#8220;<u>Underwritten Offering</u>&#8221;); <u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, that the Company may not, without SpinCo&#8217;s prior written consent, (i) launch an Underwritten Offering the anticipated gross proceeds
        (or, in the case of a Debt Exchange, the anticipated fair value of the securities Transferred or indebtedness satisfied) of which are expected to be less than $25,000,000 (unless the Company is proposing to Sell all of its remaining Registrable
        Securities), (ii) launch more than five Underwritten Offerings, and no more than three Underwritten Offerings within any twelve-month period, or (iii) launch an Underwritten Offering within a Blackout Period.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">In the event of an Underwritten Offering, the Company shall select the managing underwriter(s) to administer the Underwritten Offering; <u>provided</u> that the choice of such managing
        underwriter(s) shall be subject to the consent of SpinCo, which consent is not to be unreasonably withheld, delayed or conditioned.&#160; SpinCo and the Company will enter into an underwriting agreement in customary form with the managing underwriter or
        underwriters selected for such offering.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(c)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">If, pursuant to <u>Section 4.03(c)</u>, SpinCo defers any Registration of Registrable Securities in response to an Underwritten Offering Notice, the Company shall be entitled to withdraw such
        Underwritten Offering Notice and if it does so, such request shall not be treated for any purpose as the delivery of an Underwritten Offering Notice pursuant to <u>Section 4.04(a)</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709110"></a>Section 4.05.&#160; <u>Piggy-Back Registration</u>.&#160; If SpinCo at any time proposes or is required to Register any Common Stock under the Securities Act on its behalf or on behalf of any of its
        stockholders, on a form and in a manner that would permit Registration of the Registrable Securities (other than in connection with (i) dividend reinvestment plans, (ii) rights offerings, (iii) a Registration Statement on Form S-4 or Form S-8 or
        any similar successor form or (iv) a Shelf Registration Statement pursuant to which only the initial purchasers and subsequent transferees of debt securities of SpinCo or any of its Subsidiaries that are convertible or exchangeable for Common Stock
        and that are initially issued pursuant to Rule 144A and/or Regulation S (or any successor provisions) of the Securities Act may resell such notes and Sell shares of Common Stock into which such notes may be converted or exchanged; <u>provided</u>,
        that SpinCo may not effect any offering or Shelf Take-Down with respect to shares of Common Stock on such initial Shelf Registration Statement unless SpinCo provides the Company with a Piggy-Back Notice (as defined below) with respect to (A) such
        offering or Shelf Take-Down or (B) a concurrent Registration Statement) then SpinCo shall give the Company prompt written notice (a &#8220;<u>Piggy-Back Notice</u>&#8221;) of its intent to do so not less than 15 Business Days prior to the contemplated filing
        date for such Registration Statement.&#160; Upon the written request of the Company (a &#8220;<u>Piggy-Back Request</u>&#8221;), given within five Business Days following the time that the Company was given any such written notice (which Piggy-Back Request shall
        specify the number of Registrable Securities requested to be Registered on behalf of the Company) (the &#8220;<u>Piggy-Back Securities</u>&#8221;), SpinCo shall include in such Registration Statement, subject to the provisions of this <u>Section 4.05</u> and,
        in the case of a Registration on behalf of any of SpinCo&#8217;s stockholders, subject to the rights of such stockholders, the number of Registrable Securities set forth in such Piggy-Back Request.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">13</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div><a name="z_Toc242709111"></a><br>
      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Section 4.06.&#160; <u>Cutbacks</u>.&#160; In the event that (x) SpinCo proposes or is required (other than pursuant to a Takedown Request or Demand Request) to Register Common Stock in connection with an Underwritten Offering,
        (y) the Company has made a Piggy-Back Request in accordance with <u>Section 4.05</u> with respect to such offering and (z) a nationally recognized investment banking firm selected by SpinCo to act as managing underwriter thereof reasonably and in
        good faith shall have advised SpinCo, the Company or any other holder of Common Stock intending to offer Common Stock in the offering, as applicable (each, an &#8220;<u>Other Holder</u>&#8221;), in writing that, in its opinion, the inclusion in the
        Registration Statement of some or all the shares of Common Stock sought to be Registered by SpinCo, the Company or the Other Holder(s) would adversely affect the price or success of the offering, SpinCo shall include in such Registration Statement
        such number of shares of Common Stock as SpinCo is reasonably advised can be Sold in such offering without such an effect (the &#8220;<u>Maximum Number</u>&#8221;) as follows and in the following order of priority:</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">if such Registration is by SpinCo for its own account, (i)<font style="font-style: italic;"> first</font>, such number of Piggy-Back Securities as the Company proposes to be included pursuant to
        a Piggy-Back Request, (ii)<font style="font-style: italic;"> second</font>, to the extent the number of shares of Common Stock to be included in the Registration pursuant to clause (i) is less than the Maximum Number, such number of shares of
        Common Stock as SpinCo proposes to register for its own account, and (iii)<font style="font-style: italic;"> third</font>, to the extent the number of shares of Common Stock to be included in the Registration pursuant to the foregoing clauses (i)
        and (ii) is less than the Maximum Number, such number of shares of Common Stock as all Other Holders request to be included for their own account (with such number of shares allocated <font style="font-style: italic;">pro rata</font> among the
        Other Holders in proportion to their respective beneficial ownership of such shares); or</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">if such Registration is pursuant to the Demand Registration rights of one or more Other Holders, (i)<font style="font-style: italic;"> first</font>, such number of shares of Common Stock as the
        Company proposes to be included, (ii)<font style="font-style: italic;"> second</font>, to the extent the number of shares of Common Stock to be included in the Registration pursuant to clause (i) is less than the Maximum Number, such number of
        Shares of Common Stock as such Other Holder(s) propose to be included (with such number of shares allocated <font style="font-style: italic;">pro rata</font> among the Other Holder(s) in proportion to their respective beneficial ownership of such
        shares) and (iii)<font style="font-style: italic;"> third</font>, to the extent the number of shares of Common Stock to be included in the Registration pursuant to foregoing clauses (i) and (ii) is less than the Maximum Number, such number of
        shares of Common Stock as SpinCo requests to be included.</div>

        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">14</font></div>

      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Section 4.07.&#160; <u>Rule 144; Removal of Restrictive Legends</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">With a view to making available the benefits of Rule 144 to the Company, SpinCo agrees that, for so long as the Company owns Registrable Securities, SpinCo will use its reasonable best efforts
        to: (i) make and keep public information available, as those terms are understood and defined in Rule 144, at all times after the date of this Agreement; and (ii) furnish to the Company upon written request a written statement by SpinCo as to its
        compliance with the reporting requirements of the Exchange Act.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">For so long as the Company owns Registrable Securities, SpinCo will use reasonable best efforts to take such further necessary action as any holder of Registrable Securities may reasonably
        request in connection with the removal of any restrictive legend on the Registrable Securities being Sold, all to the extent required from time to time to enable the Company to Sell the Registrable Securities (i) pursuant to a Registration
        Statement or (ii) without Registration under the Securities Act pursuant to Rule 144.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709113"></a>Section 4.08.&#160; <u>Holdback Agreements</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">To the extent requested in writing by the managing underwriter or underwriters of any Underwritten Offering, SpinCo agrees not to, and shall use reasonable best efforts to obtain agreements (in
        the underwriters&#8217; customary form) from its directors and its officers (as such term is defined under Section 16 of the Exchange Act) not to, directly or indirectly offer, Transfer or pledge, or contract to Transfer or pledge, any equity securities
        of SpinCo during the 90 days beginning on the pricing date of such Underwritten Offering (except as part of such Underwritten Offering or any Transfer pursuant to Registrations on Form S-8 or Form S-4) unless the Company and the managing
        underwriter or underwriters otherwise agree to a shorter period.&#160; Each Person subject to the restrictions of the preceding sentence shall receive the benefit of any shorter &#8220;lock-up&#8221; period or permitted exceptions agreed to by the Company and the
        managing underwriter or underwriters for any Underwritten Offering and the terms of such lock-up agreements shall govern such Person in lieu of the preceding sentence. For the avoidance of doubt, the agreements described in the first sentence of
        this <u>Section 4.08(a)</u> shall not apply to restrict the Company or any Common Stock held by the Company.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">To the extent requested in writing by the underwriter(s) or exchanging bank(s) in connection with a Debt Exchange by the Company with respect to any of its Remaining Shares, SpinCo agrees not to,
        and shall use reasonable best efforts to obtain agreements (in the underwriters&#8217; or banks&#8217; customary form) from its directors and executive officers not to, directly or indirectly offer, Transfer or pledge, or contract to Transfer or pledge, any
        equity securities of SpinCo, during the 90 days beginning on the pricing date for such Debt Exchange unless the underwriters or banks otherwise agree to a shorter period.&#160; Each Person subject to the restrictions of the preceding sentence shall
        receive the benefit of any shorter &#8220;lock-up&#8221; period or permitted exceptions agreed to by the underwriters or banks for the Debt Exchange and the terms of such lock-up agreements shall govern such Person in lieu of the preceding sentence.&#160; For the
        avoidance of doubt, the agreements described in the first sentence of this <u>Section 4.08(b)</u> shall not apply to restrict the Company or any Common Stock held by the Company.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>

      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Section 4.09.&#160; <u>Registration Procedures</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">In connection with each Registration Statement prepared pursuant to this <u>Article IV</u> pursuant to which Registrable Securities will be offered and Sold, and in accordance with the intended
        method or methods of distribution of the Registrable Securities as described in such Registration Statement, SpinCo shall:</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(i)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">use its reasonable best efforts to, as promptly as reasonably practicable (and within the time requirements set out in this <u>Article IV</u>), prepare and submit or file with the SEC a
        Registration Statement on an appropriate Registration form of the SEC and thereafter use reasonable best efforts to cause such Registration Statement to become effective under the Securities Act promptly after the filing thereof, which Registration
        Statement shall comply as to form in all material respects with the requirements of the applicable form and include all financial statements required by such form to be submitted or filed therewith; <u>provided</u> that before filing a
        Registration Statement or Prospectus or any amendments or supplements thereto, SpinCo shall furnish to one or more legal counsel selected by the Company draft copies of all such documents proposed to be submitted or filed at least ten Business Days
        prior to such filing, which documents will be subject to the reasonable review and comment of the Company and its agents and Representatives and the underwriters, if any, and SpinCo shall not file any amendment or supplement to a Takedown
        Prospectus Supplement or Demand Registration Statement to which the Company or the underwriters, if any, shall reasonably object;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(ii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">as promptly as reasonably practicable thereafter, furnish without charge to the Company and the underwriters, if any, at least one conformed copy of the Registration Statement and each
        post-effective amendment or supplement thereto (including all schedules and exhibits but excluding all documents incorporated or deemed incorporated therein by reference, unless requested in writing by the Company or an underwriter, except to the
        extent such exhibits and schedules are currently available via the SEC&#8217;s Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis and Retrieval system (&#8220;<u>EDGAR</u>&#8221;)) and such number of copies of the Registration Statement and each amendment or supplement thereto
        (excluding exhibits and schedules) and the summary, preliminary, final, amended or supplemented Prospectuses included in such Registration Statement as the Company or the underwriters, if any, may reasonably request in order to facilitate the
        public Sale or other disposition of the Registrable Securities being Sold by the Company (SpinCo hereby consents to the use in accordance with the U.S. securities laws of such Registration Statement (or post-effective amendment thereto) and each
        such Prospectus (or preliminary Prospectus or supplement thereto) by the Company and the underwriters, if any, in connection with the offering and Sale of the Registrable Securities covered by such Registration Statement or Prospectus);</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(iii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">use its reasonable best efforts to keep such Registration Statement effective for the Effective Period, prepare and file with the SEC such amendments, post-effective amendments and supplements to
        the Registration Statement and the Prospectus as may be necessary to maintain the effectiveness of the Registration for the Effective Period and cause the Prospectus (and any amendments or supplements thereto) to be filed with the SEC;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">16</font></div>
        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;" noshade="noshade"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(iv)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">use its reasonable best efforts to, as promptly as reasonably practicable, Register or qualify the Registrable Securities covered by such Registration Statement under such other securities or
        &#8220;blue sky&#8221; laws of such jurisdictions in the United States as are reasonably necessary, keep such Registrations or qualifications in effect for so long as the Registration Statement remains in effect, and do any and all other acts and things which
        may be reasonably necessary to enable the Company or any underwriter to consummate the disposition of the Registrable Securities in such jurisdictions; <u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, that in no event shall SpinCo be required to (A) qualify to
        do business as a foreign corporation in any jurisdiction where it would not, but for the requirements of this subparagraph (iv), be required to be so qualified, (B) execute or file any general consent to service of process under the laws of any
        jurisdiction, (C) take any action that would subject it to service of process in suits other than those arising out of the offer and Sale of the securities covered by the Registration Statement, or (D) subject itself to taxation in any jurisdiction
        where it would not otherwise be obligated to do so, but for this subparagraph (iv);</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(v)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">use its reasonable best efforts to, as promptly as reasonably practicable, cause all Registrable Securities covered by such Registration Statement to be listed (after notice of issuance) on the
        NYSE or on the principal securities exchange or interdealer quotation system on which the Common Stock is then listed or quoted;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(vi)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">use its reasonable best efforts to promptly notify the Company and the managing underwriter or underwriters, if any, after becoming aware thereof, (A) when the Registration Statement or any
        related Prospectus or any amendment or supplement thereto has been filed, and, with respect to the Registration Statement or any post-effective amendment, when the same has become effective, (B) of any request by the SEC or any U.S. state
        securities authority for amendments or supplements to the Registration Statement or the related Prospectus or for additional information, (C) of the issuance by the SEC of any stop order suspending the effectiveness of the Registration Statement or
        the initiation of any proceedings for that purpose, (D) of the receipt by SpinCo of any notification with respect to the suspension of the qualification of the Registrable Securities for Sale in any jurisdiction or the initiation of any proceeding
        for such purpose or (E) within the Effective Period of the happening of any event or the existence of any fact which makes any statement in the Registration Statement or any post-effective amendment thereto, Prospectus or any amendment or
        supplement thereto, or any document incorporated therein by reference untrue in any material respect or which requires the making of any changes in the Registration Statement or post-effective amendment thereto or any Prospectus or amendment or
        supplement thereto so that they will not contain any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state any material fact required to be stated therein or necessary to make the statements therein, in light of the circumstances under which they
        were made, not misleading;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(vii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">during the Effective Period, use its reasonable best efforts to obtain, as promptly as practicable, the withdrawal of any order enjoining or suspending the use or effectiveness of the
        Registration Statement or any post-effective amendment thereto or the lifting of any suspension of the qualification of any of the Registrable Securities for Sale in any jurisdiction at the earliest date reasonably practicable;</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 54pt;">(viii)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 90pt;">use its reasonable best efforts to deliver promptly to the Company and the managing underwriters, if any, copies of all correspondence between the SEC and SpinCo, its legal counsel or auditors
        and all memoranda relating to discussions with the SEC or its staff with respect to the Registration Statement (except to the extent such correspondence is currently available via EDGAR);</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">17</font></div>

        bring-down &#8220;comfort&#8221; letter) from SpinCo&#8217;s independent public accountants (and, if necessary, any other independent certified public accountants of any Subsidiary of SpinCo, any accounting predecessor or successor to SpinCo (including, for the
        avoidance of doubt, the SpinCo Business) or any business acquired by SpinCo for which financial statements and financial data are, or are required to be, included in the Registration Statement) in customary form and covering such matters as are
        customarily covered by such opinions, negative assurance letters, &#8220;comfort&#8221; letters and bring-down &#8220;comfort&#8221; letters in connection with an offering of the nature contemplated by the applicable Registration Statement;</div>

        of any document which is to be incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement or Prospectus (after the initial filing of such Registration Statement), copies of any such document;</div>

        (including by collecting and delivering any FINRA questionnaires requested by counsel to the Company), the SEC and NYSE (or any other applicable national securities exchange);</div>

        Securities as required hereby.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">In the event that SpinCo would be required, pursuant to <u>Section 4.09(a)(vi)(E)</u>, to notify the Company or the managing underwriter or underwriters, if any, of the happening of any event
        specified therein, SpinCo shall, subject to <u>Section 4.03(c)</u>, as promptly as practicable, prepare and furnish to the Company and to each such underwriter a reasonable number of copies of a Prospectus supplemented or amended so that, as
        thereafter delivered to purchasers of Registrable Securities that have been Registered pursuant to this Agreement, such Prospectus shall not contain an untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact required to be stated
        therein or necessary to make the statements therein, in the light of the circumstances under which they were made, not misleading. The Company agrees that, upon receipt of any notice from SpinCo pursuant to <u>Section 4.09(a)(vi)(E)</u>, it shall,
        and shall use its reasonable best efforts to, cause any Sales or placement agent or agents for the Registrable Securities and the underwriters, if any, to forthwith discontinue disposition of the Registrable Securities pursuant to the Registration
        Statement to which such Prospectus relates until such Person shall have received copies of such amended or supplemented Prospectus and, if so directed by SpinCo, to destroy all copies, other than permanent file copies, then in its possession of the
        Prospectus (prior to such amendment or supplement) covering such Registrable Securities as soon as practicable after the Company&#8217;s receipt of such notice.</div>

        reasonably request in writing in order for SpinCo to comply with its obligations under all applicable securities and other laws and to ensure that the Prospectus relating to such Registrable Securities conforms to the applicable requirements of the
        Securities Act and the rules and regulations thereunder, including any financial statements or other information of the SpinCo Business relating to any date or any period ending on or prior to the Distribution Date to the extent required to be
        included or incorporated by reference in any Prospectus and not already in the possession of SpinCo.&#160; The Company shall promptly notify SpinCo of any inaccuracy or change in information previously furnished by the Company to SpinCo or of the
        occurrence of any event, in either case as a result of which any Prospectus relating to the Registrable Securities contains or would contain an untrue statement of a material fact or omits to state any material fact required to be stated therein or
        necessary to make the statements therein, in light of the circumstances under which they were made, not misleading, and promptly furnish to SpinCo any additional information required to correct and update any previously furnished information or
        required so that such Prospectus shall not contain an untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact required to be stated therein or necessary to make the statements therein, in light of the circumstances under which they
        were made, not misleading.</div>

          4.05</u> if SpinCo has entered into an underwriting agreement in connection therewith, all shares of Common Stock to be included in such offering or Registration, as the case may be, shall be subject to the applicable underwriting agreement and
        no Person may participate in such offering or Registration unless such Person agrees to Sell such Person&#8217;s securities on the basis provided therein and completes and executes all questionnaires, indemnities, underwriting agreements and other
        documents (other than powers of attorney) which must be executed in connection therewith, and provides such other information to SpinCo or the underwriter as may be reasonably requested to offer or Register such Person&#8217;s Common Stock.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709115"></a>Section 4.10.&#160; <u>No Inconsistent Agreements</u>.&#160; Without the prior written consent of the Company, for so long as the Company continues to hold any Registrable Securities, neither SpinCo
        nor any of its Subsidiaries shall enter into any agreement granting Registration or similar rights to any Person that are prior in right, <font style="font-style: italic;">pari passu</font> or inconsistent with the rights under this Agreement.&#160;
        SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> represents and warrants that it is not currently a party to any agreement providing any other person with the right to require </font>SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> to register any securities of
        </font>SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> for sale or to include such securities of </font>SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> in any Registration Statement filed by </font>SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> for the sale of
          securities for its own account or for the account of any other person, other than any such rights that </font>are not prior in right, <font style="font-style: italic;">pari passu</font> or inconsistent with the rights provided to the Company
        under this Agreement and<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> that would not otherwise conflict with the rights provided to the Company under this Agreement.</font></div>

      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc242709116"></a>Section 4.11.&#160; <u>Registration Expenses</u>.&#160; In connection with any Registration and Sale of any Registrable Securities by the Company, (i) SpinCo shall bear all reasonably incurred,
        documented and out-of-pocket Registration and filing fees, printing costs and fees and expenses of its legal counsel and accountants and, to the extent not borne by the underwriters in accordance with the terms of the applicable underwriting
        agreement, any underwriters (excluding, for the avoidance of doubt, any underwriting, placement agent or similar discounts, fees or commissions payable to investment banking or broker-dealer firms in respect of the Sale of Registrable Securities by
        the Company), except as otherwise provided in <u>Section 4.03</u> where a request is revoked at the request of the Company and (ii) the Company shall bear all reasonably incurred, documented and out-of-pocket fees and expenses of its legal
        counsel.</div>

      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">Section 4.12.&#160; <u>Indemnification; Contribution</u>.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(a)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, SpinCo shall, and it hereby agrees to, indemnify and hold harmless the Company, each underwriter and its controlling persons, directors,
        officers, advisors, agents and employees of each of the foregoing in any offering or Sale of the Registrable Securities, including pursuant to <u>Section 4.01</u>, <u>Section 4.02</u> or <u>Section 4.05</u>, against any losses, claims, damages
        or liabilities, actions or proceedings (whether commenced or threatened) in respect thereof and expenses (including actual and documented out-of-pocket fees of legal counsel reasonably incurred) (collectively, &#8220;<u>Claims</u>&#8221;) to which each such
        indemnified Person may become subject, insofar as such Claims (including any amounts paid in settlement effected with the consent of SpinCo as provided herein), or actions or proceedings in respect thereof, arise out of, relate to, are in
        connection with, or are based upon an untrue statement or alleged untrue statement of a material fact contained in any Registration Statement, or any preliminary or final Prospectus contained therein, or any amendment or supplement thereto, or any
        document incorporated by reference therein, or arise out of, relate to, are in connection with, or are based upon any omission or alleged omission to state therein a material fact required to be stated therein or necessary to make the statements
        therein, in light of the circumstances under which they were made, not misleading, and SpinCo shall, and it hereby agrees to, reimburse periodically each such indemnified Person for any actual and documented out-of-pocket legal or other actual and
        documented out-of-pocket expenses reasonably incurred by it in connection with investigating or defending any such Claims; <u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, that SpinCo shall not be liable to any such Person in any such case to the extent that any
        such Claims arise out of, relate to, are in connection with, or are based upon an untrue statement or alleged untrue statement or omission or alleged omission made in such Registration Statement, or preliminary or final Prospectus, or amendment or
        supplement thereto, in reliance upon written information furnished to SpinCo (x) by the Company or any Representative of the Company expressly for use therein, it being understood and agreed that the only such information furnished by the Company
        or any Representative of the Company consists of the information described as such in <u>Section 4.12(b)</u> or (y) by or on behalf of any underwriter expressly for use therein.</div>
      <div>&#160;</div>
      <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">(b)</div>
      <div style="margin: -12pt 0px 0px; text-indent: 54pt;">To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the Company shall, and hereby agrees to, (i) indemnify and hold harmless SpinCo, its directors, officers, advisors, agents, employees and each
        underwriter, its partners, officers, directors, employees and controlling Persons, if any, in any offering or Sale of Registrable Securities by it against any Claims to which each such indemnified Person may become subject, insofar as such Claims
        (including any amounts paid in settlement as provided herein), or actions or proceedings in respect thereof, arise out of, relate to, are in connection with, or are based upon an untrue statement or alleged untrue statement of a material fact
        contained in any Registration Statement, or any preliminary or final Prospectus contained therein, or any amendment or supplement thereto, or any document incorporated by reference therein, or <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">any such statement
          made in any free writing prospectus (as defined in Rule 405 under the Securities Act) that </font>SpinCo<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> has filed or is required to file pursuant to Rule 433(d) under the Securities Act, </font>or arise out
        of, relate to, are in connection with, or are based upon any omission or alleged omission to state therein a material fact required to be stated therein or necessary to make the statements therein not misleading, in each case only to the extent
        that such untrue statement or alleged untrue statement or omission or alleged omission was made in reliance upon and in conformity with written information regarding the Company furnished to SpinCo by the Company or any Representative of the
        Company expressly for use therein, it being understood and agreed that the only such information furnished by the Company or any Representative of the Company consists of the number of shares of Common Stock owned by the Company Group, the number
        of Registrable Securities proposed to be Sold by the Company Group, the name and address of the Company, the method of distribution (including the description of any Debt Exchange) proposed by the Company, and any financial statements or other
        information (or omissions thereof) about the SpinCo Business to the extent relating to any date or period ended on or before the Effective Date, in each case, to the extent provided by the Company or any Representative of the Company (collectively,
        the &#8220;<u>Company Information</u>&#8221;) and (ii) reimburse SpinCo for any actual and documented out-of-pocket legal or other out-of-pocket expenses reasonably incurred by SpinCo in connection with investigating or defending any such Claim; <u>provided</u>,
        <u>however</u>, that in no event shall any indemnity or reimbursement by the Company under this <u>Section 4.12(b)</u> exceed an amount equal to the net proceeds received by the Company (or, in the case of a Debt Exchange, the anticipated fair
        value of the securities Transferred or indebtedness satisfied) in respect of the Sale of Registrable Securities giving rise to such indemnification or reimbursement obligation.</div>

        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><font class="BRPFPageNumber" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif;">21</font></div>
